rendering: Imports actual AccountSettingsTab, PublicProfileTab, SubscriptionTab, AuthModal, AppShellTopBar and AvatarActionButtons. Only Index account canvas/pill JSX is reproduced. Source components are not transformed. Teaching examples are separate reference-only compositions.

views.settings: Actual settings panels, sample email/current-plan data and local password form
views.subscriptions: Actual subscription cards with fixed illustrative data; live-update text is preserved source wording
views.profile: Actual editable profile, existing local portrait, privacy checkboxes and empty published-works state

data: Fixed avery@example.invalid account and local portrait. Profile reads return fixed data; works, interactions and stats are empty/zero. Subscription prices, limits, features and badges are illustrations, not current live offers or entitlements.
mutations: Password and profile updates call a local receipt stub returning mock success. Any source success wording describes this mock result only. Auth/sign-up/OAuth return explicit local errors, without submitting credentials, redirects or sessions. No credential values are logged, returned or written. Storage/image generation/picker operations stop at local boundaries. Page CSP connect-src none also blocks fetch/XHR/WebSocket connections.
allowedInteractions: Account pill selection, password typing/reveal/validation/mock update, actual sign-in/sign-up switch and validation/reveal, profile text edits, genre add/remove, privacy checkbox state, local avatar repositioning, mock profile Save receipt and actual shared menu behavior. Teaching examples use local drafts only.
omitted: No production authentication, password change, profile persistence, OAuth, storage, subscriptions/realtime config, billing, image library, generation, public profile visibility enforcement or populated published-work grid/detail interaction. Source subscription CTA buttons have no handler and remain static. Upload-from-device may open a local file chooser; remote upload cannot occur. No browser inspection performed by this worker.
quirks: Preserved source unassociated field labels and account password reveal button without an accessible name; subscription CTA inactivity, live-data wording and duplicated free-tier feature rendering; profile privacy checkboxes do not hide the owner editor. No source semantic fixes were applied.
proof: Parent inspected imported source components, reproduced account canvas/pills, and both new compositions at stated viewports. Build/captures do not prove real authentication, updates or full production integration.

sources.role: reproduced account canvas/pill JSX owner; page is not imported
